results.description:
🍁 Autumn in Vermont means golden leaves, pumpkin spice, and a touch of small-town magic. Tour guide Autumn Ackerman loves sharing the season's charm with anyone who visits Maple Falls. But when work brings Lukas Spellman to town for just a month, their easy connection soon feels like something more.

🎃 Cozy hayrides, glowing jack-o'-lanterns, and crisp nights draw them closer—but one unexpected misunderstanding threatens to end things before they've really begun.

✨ Heartwarming, romantic, and full of fall charm, Leaving Autumn is the first book in the Sweet as Maple Syrup series—a trio of cozy, feel-good holiday romances set in picturesque Vermont. Each book celebrates a different holiday, a new love story, and a happily-ever-after. 💕❄️
